start.tagline: Solve number puzzles by deduction, with hints that explain the next step, or watch the solver do it.
start.celebrate: Confetti when you finish a puzzle
start.about: Version {{version}} · Puzzles are described as constraints over a grid of cells, and solved by propagating them.
start.openError: The file is not a valid puzzle: {{error}}
rule.sudoku: 1 to 9 once in every row, column and 3×3 box.
rule.kakuro: Fill the runs so they add up to their clues, without repeating a digit.
rule.futoshiki: A Latin square: every row and column once, and every < and > holds.
rule.jidoku: Sudoku without given numbers: only < and > between neighbours in a box.
rule.sumbrero: Follow each clue's triangle: the hexagons in that direction add up to the clue, without repeating a digit.
rule.nonogram: Fill in cells so every row and column has blocks of the lengths of its clue, in that order.
help.title: How to play
help.values1: Tap a cell (or use the arrow keys), then tap a number or type it to enter it.
help.values2: Clear, Delete or Backspace empties the cell.
help.notes1: Turn on Notes (or press N) to note candidates: a number notes it, again removes it.
help.notes2: Ctrl+number notes a candidate without turning on notes mode.
help.toolbar1: Undo and Redo (Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Y) step through your changes.
help.toolbar2: Hint shows a bit more on every press: where to look, the cell, then the value and why.
help.toolbar3: Step fills in one value, Solve the whole puzzle, Check compares your entries with the solution.
help.switches1: Show hints: show the candidates that are left in open cells and in the descriptions.
help.switches2: Allow guessing: let Step and Solve guess when nothing follows from the rules.
help.switches3: Colour symbols (nonograms with several colours): draw a shape for every colour too, so colours that look alike can be told apart.
guide.title: {{type}}: rules and techniques
legend.peer: shares a group with the cell
legend.pattern: where the value can still go
legend.reason: number that leads to the hint
legend.ruledOut: value ruled out by a highlighted number
legend.reasonGroup: group through which a number rules a value out
legend.techniqueGroup: group that cannot hold the value outside the pattern
legend.techniqueRuledOut: value ruled out by the pattern
placements.block: The {{line}} now (grey: open), then every place block {{block}} can go: each covers the outlined cell.
placements.blockOthers: The {{line}} now (grey: open), then every place block {{block}} can go, with the other blocks (pale) pushed as far from it as they fit: each covers the outlined cell.
placements.waysOnly: the only way its blocks fit
placements.waysSome: {{shown}} of the {{total}} ways its blocks fit
placements.makes_other: every one makes the outlined cell {{value}}
placements.excludes_one: it does not give the outlined cell the removed colour
placements.excludes_other: none gives the outlined cell the removed colour
info.empty: Tap a cell in the puzzle, or select a cell, group or rule in the list, to see its cells and rules.
session.busy: The solver is busy; wait for it or cancel it first.
hint.messageCandidates: Hint: {{message}} (This uses the candidates the solver keeps; turn on Show hints to see them.)

notice.noHint: No value follows from a single round of the rules, and no technique applies. Use Step to narrow down the candidates, or Solve.

notice.noProgressGuessing: A deduction step does not change the puzzle any further. Use Solve to continue by guessing.
check.title: Check
